action: Osaki asks recipients to be wary of suspicious emails and calls claiming to be from the company.
exec: Osaki Electric says production and shipping of smart meters remain suspended, with no restart date, and that technical information apparently from its systems was posted online.
plain: Japanese smart meter maker Osaki Electric says ransomware encrypted data on its servers and that technical information apparently from its systems was posted online. Production and shipping are suspended, with no restart date.

key_findings: Osaki says it found data on its servers encrypted around 10:35 JST on November 17 and cut external network connections after noon.
It stopped production systems at its Saitama site and related plants (Iwate Osaki Electric, Osaki Platec), so smart meters cannot be produced or shipped.
It is investigating with outside specialists, including whether data left the company, and has told police and authorities.
No restart date is set; the effect on results is not yet known.
recommendations: Beware of suspicious emails and calls claiming to be from Osaki.

summary: Osaki Electric, a Japanese smart meter maker, says it found its servers encrypted on November 17 in a ransomware attack, and that the attacker got in through a VPN device whose authentication was bypassed. Nikkei reports Osaki announced on November 25 a staged production restart from November 27, with shipments and new orders expected in early December. Rocket Boys reports Qilin listed Osaki.
title: Osaki Electric halts smart meter production after ransomware attack

validation.note: Primary source: Osaki Electric notice of 18 Nov (first report). Business+IT (sbbit.jp, 18 Nov) relays the same notice: encryption found 17 Nov about 10:35, Saitama, Iwate Osaki Denki and Osaki Platec production systems stopped, restart undetermined. On 22 Nov osaki.co.jp returned 403, so no later report could be checked; Business+IT mentions none. Update 2026-11-24T06:40:44Z: Osaki second report of 20 Nov read (data posted online, VPN device authentication bypassed, restart undetermined); Rocket Boys relays the Qilin leak-site listing, which Osaki has not confirmed. Update 2026-11-25: Nikkei (25 Nov) reports phased production restart from 27 Nov, per Osaki announcement; Osaki page not re-read.
